description: vpc-a routes 10.1.0.0/16 to peer B but a more specific 10.1.1.0/24 to peer C. Longest prefix wins, and peering is not transitive, so 10.1.1.0/24 becomes unreachable from A.

paths.name: 10.1.2.10 matches only the /16 and goes to pcx-ab
10.1.1.10 matches the /24 to pcx-ac first; vpc-c does not contain it and will not forward
